title: Add run lifecycle observability and cleanup
description:
Make long-running and failed orchestrator runs understandable and maintainable. Operators and AI agents should be able to see what happened, recover safely, and clean up old workspaces without losing durable proof.

Acceptance:
- Run records include concise status, evidence, and useful error tails.
- Stale leases and retry paths are explicit.
- Workspace retention/cleanup policy is configurable and safe.
